description:
Lawful development: Existing use.
The certificate relates to the whole of the property known as 30 Rowley Road, Tottenham, London N15 3AX — the entire building and its curtilage, edged red on the location plan and comprising the registered freehold title NGL425964.
The existing use for which the certificate is sought is the use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation falling within Use Class C4 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) — that is, occupation of the dwellinghouse by between three and six unrelated persons who do not form a single household and who share basic amenities.
The property is arranged over ground and first floors and contains six letting rooms (Rooms 1 to 6) together with a shared kitchen/dining room, a shared bathroom, a separate WC and a separate shower room. There are no self-contained cooking or washing facilities within any individual room. The use applies to the whole of the building; with six rooms the maximum occupation is six persons, placing the use within Class C4 (and below the seven-person threshold for a sui generis HMO).
This application concerns a change of use only. No building or other operational works form part of this application. The Class C4 use has subsisted continuously since no later than 1 April 2015 (and, on the wider evidence, since September 2014) — a period substantially in excess of ten years. The use is therefore lawful and immune from enforcement action under sections 171B(3) and 191 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as set out in the accompanying Planning Statement and evidence bundle.
